title: knowledge.component_matched.v1
description: Integration-contract v1 for the ComponentMatched correlation event payload (M5 EB-03; current wire shape frozen). Governance consumes it to create a Finding; it is a Proposal, not truth.

Source.description: Upstream SOURCE-package name for distro components; additive/omitempty (AI-GROUND-1).

ClaimClass.description: Why this component matched; absent = unknown, treated as carrier (EDR-CORRELATION-01 D3). Additive/omitempty.

DetectionOrigin.description: Which engine produced the match: `discovery` or `scanner/<name>` (bare `scanner` when the report names no engine). Display provenance, never authority; absent on older payloads (KN-SCAN-2). Additive/omitempty.

Score.description: Card's CVE-intrinsic composite score at match time (C6); optional — 0 when an older payload omits it. Governance stamps base_score at finding-open (BUG-3).

Priority.description: Card's priority band at match time; additive/omitempty (BUG-3b).

Fixes.description: Card's published fix versions at match time; additive/omitempty (BUG-3b, ecosystem added by KN-FIX-3).
